summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] union member; rich/control.py adds the title escape format and Control.title(); rich/console.py adds set_window_title() beside show_cursor (returns True only when is_terminal, else False); rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking #2200; tests added in test_console.py (skipped on win32), test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Tests, mypy, and Black were not run, per instructions; everything was verified by reading only. Title text is written unmodified, as the spec requires, so embedded BEL or ESC characters could break the sequence. Nothing was committed.
